EnBuds Pro Earbuds TWS-05 – Premium Wireless Sound with Bluetooth 5.3

Experience powerful audio performance and all-day comfort with the EnBuds Pro Earbuds TWS-05, designed for users who demand clarity, stability, and long battery life in true wireless earbuds. Built with Bluetooth Version 5.3, these earbuds ensure faster pairing, lower latency, and a more stable wireless connection, making them ideal for music, calls, gaming, and daily commuting.

The feature an advanced acoustic setup with a 13mm speaker driver that delivers deep bass, balanced mids, and crisp highs across a wide frequency range of 20Hz–20kHz. Whether you enjoy bass-heavy tracks, podcasts, or clear voice calls, these earbuds provide an immersive and distortion-free listening experience.

Long-Lasting Battery for All-Day Use

Designed for extended usage, each is powered by a 50mAh battery, offering an impressive working time of about 11 hours per charge. The compact charging case comes with a 500mAh battery, allowing multiple recharges on the go. With a standby time of up to 100 hours, the are always ready when you need them.

The efficient power management ensures that the recharge quickly, with a charging time of about 2 hours. This makes them perfect for professionals, travelers, and fitness enthusiasts who need reliable performance without frequent charging interruptions.

Stable Connectivity & Wide Compatibility

Thanks to Bluetooth Version 5.3, the deliver seamless connectivity with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices. Enjoy a stable wireless connection with a Bluetooth range of up to 10 meters, allowing you to move freely without signal drops.

The low-latency connection enhances audio-video synchronization, making these an excellent choice for streaming videos, online meetings, and casual gaming. Built-in noise reduction helps ensure clearer voice transmission during calls.

Comfortable Design with Powerful Audio Output

Crafted for comfort and durability, the ergonomic design of the ensures a secure fit for extended listening sessions. The lightweight construction reduces ear fatigue, while the in-ear design helps with passive noise isolation for a more focused sound experience.

The large 13mm driver enhances sound depth and volume output, making these suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. From workouts and travel to office calls and entertainment, these earbuds adapt effortlessly to your lifestyle.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Model: EnBuds Pro Earbuds TWS-05
  • Bluetooth Version: 5.3
  • Frequency Response: 20Hz – 20kHz
  • Speaker Driver: 13mm dynamic driver
  • Earbud Battery: 50mAh (each)
  • Charging Case Battery: 500mAh
  • Working Time: About 11 hours per charge
  • Charging Time: About 2 hours
  • Standby Time: About 100 hours
  • Bluetooth Range: Up to 10 meters

The combine advanced wireless technology, powerful sound output, and long-lasting battery life in a compact form factor. With high search demand for Bluetooth featuring extended playback time, fast charging, and reliable connectivity, this model stands out as a value-packed solution. Whether you are looking for true wireless for daily use, fitness activities, or professional calls, the deliver consistent performance, comfort, and audio quality that meets modern expectations.
